Chapter 902: Chapter 7 The Sixth Physical Body Divine Ability

Chapter 902: Chapter 7 The Sixth Physical Body Divine Ability

Inside the A-grade cave mansion.

“Master, the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall requests you to refine fifty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills.”

“And is willing to pay with three shares of ‘Immortal Sources’ as compensation?”

Below, Yun Zhenzi asked cautiously.

As the ‘housekeeper’ of this cave mansion, he handled many trifling matters.

Most things, Lin Yuan would not keep from Yun Zhenzi.

“That’s right.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

His mood was quite pleasant.

He had originally thought that it would be a while before he had any dealing with ‘Immortal Sources’, unreachable through conventional means.

But the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, to actually take the initiative to use ‘Immortal Sources’ as compensation?

This indeed spared Lin Yuan a lot of trouble, at least there was no need for him to act personally.

“The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall…”

Yun Zhenzi thought for a moment and couldn’t help saying, “Master, it is said that the Azure Dragon Sect Master of the Nine Dragons Commerce Association is overbearing in his actions, but in truth, in terms of being overbearing, the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall goes even further.”

“In front of the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, not one of the nine Jade Immortal Sect Masters of the Nine Dragons Commerce Association dares to act rashly.”

Having said this, Yun Zhenzi continued to ponder for a while before saying, “This time, the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, by half selling and half giving, brought out three shares of Immortal Sources as compensation, Master still needs to be a little careful.”

Logically speaking, refining fifty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills doesn’t warrant compensation with three shares of Immortal Sources, especially when the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall personally comes to the door.

But such an incident has occurred, which makes Yun Zhenzi faintly sense that something is not quite right.

“Be careful?”

Lin Yuan was calm in his heart.

If you talk about five hundred years ago, when his consciousness had just arrived in the Immortal Realm, facing the colossal Cangwu Immortal City, he needed to be cautious and prudent.

But now?

In front of Lin Yuan, almost the entire Cangwu Immortal City appeared as fragile as thin paper.

Even if the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall were to scheme against Lin Yuan, it would be meaningless in front of absolute strength.

Moreover, before the three shares of Immortal Sources arrived in his hands, Lin Yuan would not hand over the refined Nine Revolutions Golden Pills, the initiative all lies with him.

…

Not long after the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall left.

A Golden Immortal from the Cangwu Immortal City delivered a large batch of resources, which were the main and auxiliary materials for refining the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill.

The reason why the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill is so rare is twofold.

One is that some of the main materials are scarce, and the other is that the difficulty of refining is great.

As a result, there are almost no Nine Revolutions Golden Pills circulated on the market; whenever Alchemy Masters refine a Nine Revolutions Golden Pill, either they keep it for themselves or sell it immediately.

“Let’s begin the refining.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the main and auxiliary materials and decided to make it a quick battle.

Other Alchemy Masters, even the most top-tier ones, would need to sit in meditation for at least several months to adjust their state to perfection if they wanted to start refining Immortal Pills at the level of the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill.

But Lin Yuan doesn’t need to go through such trouble; the intensity of his 12th Layer mental will allows his alchemy to proceed smoothly.

Time passed.

One month later.

Inside the cave mansion, Lin Yuan opened his eyes, and in front of him, the pill furnace rotated, with fragrance wafting around; an ordinary mortal taking a single breath of it could extend their lifespan by hundreds of thousands of years.

The Nine Revolutions Golden Pill, which can instantaneously cure all injuries at the Golden Immortal level, contains an immense vitality force that one can imagine.

“Almost done.”

Lin Yuan took a look and nodded slightly.

In fact, refining this batch of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills was just one of the avatars he had split off; his true body and two great Primordial Spirits continued to comprehend many laws.

“Next, it’s time to endure the heavenly tribulation.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Why is it called ‘Nine Revolutions’? it is because to become a pill, it needs to go through nine heavenly tribulations.

With the endless destructive vitality in the heavenly tribulation, the pill can complete the final step of becoming a pill.

And the most difficult part of refining the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill lies in the heavenly tribulation; to pass through nine heavenly tribulations places extremely high demands on the Immortal Pill itself.

The vast majority of Nine Revolutions Golden Pills are destroyed under the heavenly tribulation, because the various medicinal forces inside the Immortal Pill have not perfectly fused, unable to withstand the heavenly tribulation.

…

Every day, a large number of immortals enter and leave Cangwu Immortal City, mostly at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage and the Mahayana Realm, with the occasional traces of Golden Immortals.

Compared to the huge number of immortals, the number of Golden Immortals is quite scarce, and as for Jade Immortals?

Jade Immortals basically reside in the A-grade cave mansion area; they only need to approach the Immortal City within a certain range to directly enter the cave mansions with their Cave Dwelling Jade Tokens.

At this very moment.

A pressing force coming from between heaven and earth began to sweep down invisibly.

Above the firmament, wisps of black tribulation clouds began to gather, with purple lightning rolling like dragons.

“What?”

“What’s that?”

“Is that tribulation clouds? Is someone about to transcend the tribulation?”

“It’s not a person transcending tribulation, it’s an Immortal Pill transcending tribulation; there’s an Alchemy Master refining a Nine Revolutions Golden Pill.”

Many immortals swiftly discussed, with a minority of experienced and knowledgeable immortals immediately recognizing the source of the tribulation clouds.

There are subtle differences between the tribulation clouds condensed by immortals undergoing tribulation and those by Immortal Pills undergoing tribulation.

And Immortal Pills undergoing tribulation? The most famous of them are Nine Revolutions Golden Pills. This life-saving Immortal Pill, even powerful Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals, desire it immensely.

“Nine Revolutions Golden Pill, exactly, I’ve seen a few Alchemy Masters refining Nine Revolutions Golden Pills before, and many failed at the final heavenly tribulation.”

“I wonder which Alchemy Master from our Cangwu Immortal City is starting the pill furnace.”

One by one, the immortals watched carefully, witnessing an Alchemy Master refining a Nine Revolutions Golden Pill—a rare scene not often observed, hoping they might gain some insights from it.

…

“Hm?”

“Nine Revolutions Golden Pill?”

“Is it Yun Zhenzi who is refining the Nine Revolutions Golden Pill?”

In another A-grade cave mansion, the Azure Dragon Sect Master from the Nine Dragons Commerce Association also noticed the scent of tribulation clouds.

For a Jade Immortal, it is easy to sense the targeted range of the tribulation clouds above the firmament, precisely over the A-grade cave mansion where Yun Zhenzi is located.
